subject: Request: tenant data erasure proof & chronology
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@northbridge-audit.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: tenant data erasure proof & chronology

Hi Jordan,

As part of AuroraFin's SOC 2 re-assessment we're collecting independent evidence for tenant-level erasures (customer-requested deletions and tenant offboarding). Can you provide the following for tenant aurorafin-prod for the date range 2026-04-01 to 2026-11-01: 

- A concise chronology of deletion events (timestamps + actor/service) showing when the erasure was initiated and completed.
- Samples of the deletion audit logs (redacted where appropriate) showing the TTL/erase job runs and confirmations.
- Evidence that the deletion propagated to backups/archives or an explanation of backup retention and eradication plan.
- Details on how erasure is reflected in your platform (KV cache, object store, snapshots), including any automated retention-to-TTL mappings.

Please include filenames for attachments and any links to internal runbooks. We prefer CSV + PDF artifacts and a short narrative. If you need clarification on scope (tenant vs. sub-tenant objects), let me know.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Senior Auditor
Northbridge Audit Services

--
Attachment placeholders: none in this initial request
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@northbridge-audit.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: tenant data erasure proof & chronology

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to provide the artifacts. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly: 

1) For "propagated to backups/archives", do you need a sample proof of restoration-and-check (i.e., show that the deleted objects are absent when restoring a snapshot) or is an architectural attest + retention table acceptable? 
2) For the timeframe, you mention 2026-04-01 to 2026-11-01; do you need every erase job or a stratified sample (e.g., 3 deletions across high/medium/low activity days)?

Planned deliverables: 
- Chronology CSV (erase-chronology-aurorafin.csv) — includes job id, initiating principal, service, start/end timestamps, affected object count.
- Log excerpts (erase-log-sample-aurorafin.csv) — redacted on tenant IDs where necessary.
- TTL mapping PDF (retention-to-ttl-mapping-2026-10.pdf) — explains how retention policies translate to TTLs in our runtime.
- Backup/restore note + sample snapshot runbook.

We can compile and send by tomorrow EOD PST if that timeline works. If you prefer staged delivery (chronology first, logs later) we can do that too.

Jordan
Head of Technical Accounts, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment placeholders: proposed filenames included above

Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@northbridge-audit.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: tenant data erasure proof & chronology

Jordan / Olivia — looping in the retention and infra owners for artifact pickup. Drafting the chronology now; attaching a sample of the log export and the TTL mapping PDF for initial review. 

Summary of what's attached (drafts):
- erase-log-sample-aurorafin.csv (redacted): shows job_id, initiator, stage (queued/running/completed), object_count.
- retention-to-ttl-mapping-2026-10.pdf: maps compliance retention policies -> system TTLs and shows automation that converts retention policy changes into TTL values used by the eviction/deletion pipeline.

Notes: 
- Backups: our standard snapshot cadence is daily incremental + weekly full snapshots retained for 90 days for hosted customers. For AuroraFin's dedicated pool we have a 30-day full snapshot retention by contract; we will provide the snapshot deletion choreography and a sampling proof (see runbook link below).

Runbook link (internal): https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/aurorafin-erasure-evidence/runbooks/erasure-propagation.md

I'll prepare the chronology CSV next and a short narrative for the backup propagation.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Platform Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: erase-log-sample-aurorafin.csv; retention-to-ttl-mapping-2026-10.pdf
From: Audit Support <auditsupport@northbridge-audit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@northbridge-audit.com>, AuroraFin Security <security@aurorafin.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:07:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: additional detail requested re: backups and snapshots

Hi Mina / Jordan,

Thanks for the early artifacts — useful. A couple of follow-ups after an initial read: 

- For the sample log CSV, can you include the hash of the affected object key (redacted tenant id but provide object-hash) so we can validate absence across snapshots? Hashes should be SHA256 or similar.
- For snapshots: please provide the snapshot manifest (dates + manifest id) for the period and a one-paragraph description of how you ensure snapshot deletion completes (e.g., snapshot tombstone + physical block reclamation).
- If you have automated verification runs (periodic integrity checks that confirm deletions are enforced), please include the last run result and an explanation of failure handling.

If possible, compile these into a single zip with a short cover note to help our review. We're targeting a preliminary SOC evidence review by 2026-11-30.

Best,
Audit Support
Northbridge Audit Services

--

- deletion-chain-snapshot-20261123.zip (contains):
  - erase-chronology-aurorafin.csv (job ids + timestamps + initiating principal)
  - erase-log-sample-aurorafin.csv (redacted tenant ids + object_hash (SHA256) column included)
  - snapshot-manifest-202604-202611.pdf (manifest ids, dates, retention actions)
  - verification-run-last.txt (integrity-check result, 2026-11-22: PASS)

- Drive link with runbook and automated verification schedule: https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/aurorafin-erasure-evidence
- HubSpot ticket: #HS-18492 (customer request + evidence bundle attached)
- Jira item for internal tracking: SEC-4721 (erasure evidence delivery)

Timeline: we will retain the compiled package for 30 days on the shared drive and can re-run the integrity check if you need a freshly timed proof prior to 2026-11-30. If you want a restore-and-verify exercise for a sample snapshot to show absence after restore, we can schedule a short controlled test (requires AuroraFin approval).

Please confirm receipt and whether the package meets your scope. Happy to open a short call to walk through the artifacts.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Technical Accounts, Redwood Inference
